## How it works. Real confidence.

### Start your daily warmup

Open the app and do a short morning voice session. No script, no pressure. Just warm up your voice and get out of your head before the day starts.

### Practice real scenarios

Choose from 63 real-life situations and talk to the AI out loud: small talk, awkward moments, dating, work, and more. It responds like a real person.

### See exactly where you grew

Get a full session analysis after every conversation. Watch your Convo Index climb as recovery, composure, and structure improve over time.

## Watch your confidence become a number that climbs.

The Convo Index is a 0–1,000 score that breaks every session into five dimensions: Recovery, Composure, Structure, Pace, and Voice. After each conversation, you see exactly where you're strong and exactly where to push next.

## Questions answered.

Is there an AI I can actually have a conversation with to practice?

Most apps make you record yourself and wait for feedback. Convo uses OpenAI's Realtime API to hold a live, back-and-forth voice conversation. The AI responds while you're speaking, asks follow-ups, and pushes back. It's the difference between rehearsing and actually practicing.

Can AI help with social anxiety?

For the behavioral side (freezing up, losing your train of thought, avoiding conversations you dread): yes. A 2023 study in JMIR Mental Health found AI-driven exposure exercises reduced social anxiety symptoms significantly with at least three sessions per week. AI is practice, not therapy, but for most people that's exactly the gap.

How do I know if I'm actually getting better?

Self-assessment after a hard conversation is unreliable. Anxiety makes you feel like you did worse than you did. Convo tracks a Confidence Index across every session so you can see the trend over 30 days, not just how you felt in the moment.

How is Convo different from other apps?

Most apps have you record a monologue and score your delivery — useful for articulation, not for anxiety. Convo puts you in a real conversation with pushback, follow-ups, and uncertainty, because that's what actually causes anxiety. It also scores anxiety-specific dimensions like Recovery (did you push through the stumble?) that solo-recording apps can't measure.

What kind of scenarios can I practice?

Job interviews, difficult conversations at work, phone calls to strangers, first meetings, salary negotiations, and more. Scenarios are designed around the situations that actually trigger conversation anxiety, not generic presentation exercises.

How often should I practice to see results?

Research on exposure therapy suggests 3–5 sessions per week. Convo's Daily Warmup is 2–4 minutes; conversation sessions run 5–10 minutes. Most users see their Confidence Index start climbing within two weeks.

What is the best app for social anxiety and conversation practice?

Most apps in this space focus on mindfulness or journaling. They help you think about anxiety, not practice through it. Convo is the only iOS app built specifically around live voice conversation practice using AI. If your anxiety shows up in actual conversations and not just in your head, Convo is built for that gap.

### Convo vs. Wellspoken: Which AI App Is Right for You?

Both Convo and Wellspoken use AI to help you get better at talking. Both give you a score after each session. Both have iOS apps with subscription pricing. The similarity ends there — because they're solving different problems, and which one is right for you depends entirely on which problem you have.
